Question 1
?

Which of the following is equivalent to the line integral of the function f(x,y)=ln⁡(x+y), traversed along the line segment from (1,3) to (0,3)?

a
∫01ln⁡(2−t)dt
b
∫01ln⁡(4−t)dt
c
∫01ln⁡(3−2t)dt
d
2∫01ln⁡(4−t)dt
e
2∫01ln⁡(3−2t)dt
